academies.title: Academies
academies.body: Every academy on AcademyBee. Create one, open its address, or change its status.

empty.title: No academies yet
empty.body: Create the first academy to give its owner their own AcademyBee address.

noResults.title: No academies match
noResults.body: Try another name or address, or clear the search.

create.title: Create an academy
create.body: The owner gets an email to choose a password. A short guided setup takes them from there.

fields.name: Academy name
fields.typeHint: Sets the words the academy sees, such as Class or Batch. They can change them later.
fields.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 42 characters.
fields.ownerHint: The invitation goes here. It expires in 7 days.
fields.planHint: Every new academy starts with a 30-day trial. Payments work on every plan.
fields.branchHint: Leave it empty to call it “Main branch”.

slug.reserved: This address is reserved. Choose another.

invalid.format: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.
invalid.double_hyphen: Don't use two hyphens in a row.

slug.unavailable: Can't check the address right now. It is checked again when you create the academy.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.slugTaken: Someone just took this address. Choose one of the alternatives.

created.title: {academy} is ready
created.body: Share the address with the owner. They will also get an email invitation to set up the academy.
created.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it yourself.

actions.heading: Actions
actions.resent: A new invitation is on its way to {email}.

dialog.reasonHint: Kept in the academy's audit log.

suspend.title: Suspend {academy}?
suspend.body: Everyone at the academy is signed out and sees a “suspended” page. Their data stays as it is.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {academy}?
reactivate.body: The academy opens again as it was before the suspension. People sign in again.

activate.title: Activate {academy} now?
activate.body: The academy opens for everyone, even if the owner hasn't finished the guided setup.

archive.title: Archive {academy}?
archive.body: The academy closes for good: everyone is signed out and its address shows a “closed” page. This can't be undone in the console.

domain.currentHint: Where the academy's owner, staff and parents sign in.
domain.redirectsHint: These keep sending visitors to the current address. No other academy can use them.
domain.changeBody: The old address keeps working: it sends visitors to the new one. People already signed in sign in again on the new address.
domain.unchanged: That is already the academy's address.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Try again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
errors.offline: You're offline. Console changes need a connection.
errors.notFound: This academy no longer exists or the link is wrong.
errors.invalidState: This academy's status changed in the meantime. Reload to see it.
errors.forbidden: Your console role can't do this.
errors.conflict: That can't be done for this academy right now.
errors.unavailable: The console can't reach academy data right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.loadBody: Check your connection and try again.

permission.title: Not available for your role
permission.body: Your console role doesn't include this. Ask a Super Admin if you need it.
